headline: Oracle Stock Rises Following New Financial Targets and AI Cash-Flow Plan
summary: Oracle shares jumped after the enterprise software provider released updated financial targets outlining a path to positive cash flow. The new guidance eased investor concerns regarding heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
why: Oracle is a leading provider of database software and cloud infrastructure that has expanded aggressively into cloud hosting for artificial intelligence workloads.
why_moved: Clarification of AI spending and positive cash-flow guidance relieved investor anxiety over capital expenditure, driving buying interest in Oracle shares.
